Implemented **Apex Tower**, an animated 3D multi-floor office building simulation that runs directly from a `file://` URL using classic `<script>` tags (no build process, ES modules, import maps, or `fetch()`).

### Files Created
- `index.html` — Application shell, HUD layout, and classic UMD Three.js r128 + simulation scripts.
- `styles.css` — Glassmorphic architectural HUD styling, inspector cards, elevator telemetry widgets, and floating activity badges.
- `js/config.js` — Building geometry constants, 7-level floor definitions (Ground Lobby through Rooftop Terrace), camera presets, worker profiles, and shared utilities (`window.OfficeSim`).
- `js/textures.js` — Procedural Canvas2D PBR textures for terrazzo marble, oak/birch flooring, carpet tiles, cedar deck, granite plaza pavers, asphalt roads, glowing computer monitors, whiteboards, and surrounding city facades.
- `js/camera.js` — Custom damped `CameraController` with orbit, pan, zoom, WASD/arrow movement, floor focus, camera presets, slow cinematic auto-orbit, and entity-following mode.
- `js/environment.js` — Dynamic day-night sky/sun/starfield cycle, soft sun shadows, granite plaza, animated water fountain, trees, benches, streetlamps, animated two-way avenue traffic with night headlights/taillights, drifting clouds, and neighboring city skyline.
- `js/building.js` — Multi-floor architectural tower with **Cutaway**, **Full Glass**, and **Isolate Floor** view modes:
  - **L (Ground Lobby)**: Reception desk, security turnstiles, lounge sofas, espresso kiosk, animated sliding glass entrance doors, and entrance canopy.
  - **1F (Café & Commons)**: Espresso bar, snack station, bistro dining tables, and commons lounge.
  - **2F (Engineering)**: 12 dual-monitor workstations, glass Sprint Room 2A with whiteboard, blinking server racks, and coffee bar.
  - **3F (Design Studio)**: 8 studio desks, glass Studio 3A conference room with presentation screen, and tea/coffee bar.
  - **4F (Operations & Sales)**: 12 workstations, acoustic glass phone booths, collaboration table, and kitchenette.
  - **5F (Executive Suite)**: Corner executive offices, central Executive Boardroom, and espresso bar.
  - **RF (Rooftop Terrace)**: Elevator penthouse, cedar pergola lounge, outdoor café tables, glass railings, planters, and spinning HVAC units.
- `js/elevator.js` — Dual-car traction elevator system with smooth acceleration/braking kinematics, animated cables & counterweights, synchronized hall/cab sliding doors, hall call lanterns, LOOK/SCAN dispatch scheduling, capacity management, and wait-time telemetry.
- `js/worker.js` — Articulated 3D office workers with walk cycles, seated desk/meeting postures, keyboard typing, coffee cups, and presenter gestures; corridor-based pathfinding, elevator queuing/boarding/riding, staggered daily schedules, coffee/lunch breaks, and evening departures.
- `js/simulation.js` — Central workday clock, speed/time-jump controls, automated conference room meeting scheduler, lobby door proximity sensor, live KPI tracking, and office activity feed.
- `js/ui.js` — Interactive floor navigator, view mode & camera preset controls, live elevator bank cards, raycasted worker/elevator inspector with camera-follow, and projected 2D worker activity badges.
- `js/main.js` — WebGLRenderer bootstrap, raycasting click selection, floor isolation visibility sync, and main animation loop.

### Verification
- Verified JavaScript syntax across all 10 files in `js/` with `node --check`.
